title: Your Body If You Walk BACKWARDS Every Day
sources: Alghadir, Anwer & Shakoor? 2019 randomized 6-week trial: retro walking reduced knee pain and improved function and quadriceps strength in knee osteoarthritis (PMC6456984)
Gondhalekar & Deo 2013 randomized trial: retro walking as adjunct treatment reduced knee OA pain and disability (PMC3624710)
American College of Sports Medicine: backward walking burns roughly forty percent more calories per minute than brisk forward walking
Cleveland Clinic + National Geographic reviews: backward walking may improve balance and posture; fall risk is the main safety caveat, so a flat, clear area with eyes up is the safe setting

lines.text: if you walked backwards every day?
Well, a six-week study had people with knee pain walk backwards,
and their knee pain dropped, while their thighs got stronger.
Going backwards loads your quads instead of your kneecap,
and burns about forty percent more calories than going forward.
Plus your brain plans every step,
so balance and focus actually improve.
But the twist: walk without watching, and people trip.
So flat floor only, twenty minutes, eyes up, no phone.
And when the whole park stares at you walking backwards,
smile back — that's exactly what getting ahead looks like.
